model.compile(optimizer=tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(learning_rate=1.0),
              loss='sparse_categorical_crossentropy',
              metrics=['accuracy'])

history = model.fit(
    train_images,
    train_labels,
    epochs=5
)

plt.plot(history.history['loss'])
plt.xlabel('epoch')
plt.ylabel('loss')
plt.title('Training loss')
plt.show()
